description: Mark an issue as actively being worked at the start of an agent's turn.

activity.description: What the agent is doing this turn: 'triaging' | 'fixing' | 'reviewing'.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

issue_url.description: The issue's actual GitHub URL (gh issue view <n> --json url). Required: an Issue node is never created without its URL.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

title.description: Issue title (sets it if the node is new; omit to leave as-is).

worked_by.description: The agent role picking it up: 'porter' | 'journeyman' | 'qa'.
